title: 'Luppius tuus' (Florentine chancery) to Niccolo Machiavelli at the French court, letter in cipher, [14 August] 1510 (catalogue 1549)

documents.date: 14 [Aug] 1510 (day and year in the manuscript; the month is the editors')

plaintext.source: Fachard (ed.), Legazioni. Commissarie. Scritti di governo, VI (Rome 2011), doc. 269, pp. 490-492

transcription.notes: Not transcribed. BNCF images (Internet Culturale, about 900 px) seen: about 26 lines of cipher on c. 1r, 6 on c. 1v.

system.summary: Symbol substitution, written without word division, in the repertoire of the 1510 Dieci letters; not analysed here.
system.notes: Glossed siblings of 1510 in the same collection (IV/111, V/61, V/67, V/123, I/81); key sheets VI/82 viewed, not applied.

prior_solution.where: Fachard (2011), VI, doc. 269, pp. 490-492 (Italian text with the editors' marks for deciphered passages)

conditions.human_role: Andrew Aymeloglu identified the chancery connection (issue #590). AI agents located Fachard's printed text (PR #804) and checked Simonetta's published attribution for Andrew Beling. No person has checked this comparison.

solution.what: Vetting 29 Oct 2026: known.py, web searches for a decipherment or edition; Tommasini and the Machiavelli editions not opened.
BNCF images of I/3 c. 1r-1v viewed (Internet Culturale MagExport), 2 Nov 2026: whole letter in cipher, no gloss or clear copy on the leaves.
Tommasini II (1911) pp. 1352-1353 read on archive.org (14 Nov 2026, issue #590): sender is a chancery clerk, not the Dieci; letter 'tutta in cifra, senza decifrato'.
Fachard (2011), VI, doc. 269, pp. 490-492 named by PR #804 (19 Nov 2026): prints the letter deciphered, month August editorial; accepted from the PR's citation, printed pages not read here.

Compared Fachard VI, doc. 269, with Simonetta in Lettere (2022), II, pp. 834–836, 848. Simonetta identifies Giovanni da Poppi as the writer of the 17 August letter and proposes that I/3 is the letter he sent three days earlier.

outcome.method_basis: No reading was made here; the letter is already printed deciphered (Fachard 2011), so the entry was closed from the evidence without a transcription or key of ours.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No sign was given a value here.

gaps.item: alignment of the print with the signs of I/3
gaps.detail: not attempted; the print is the only plaintext and no key was rebuilt

credits.note: Identified the sender as a chancery clerk and found Tommasini's excerpts (issue #590).
Identified the printed reading: Fachard (2011), VI, doc. 269 (PR #804, with AI agents; not checked by a person).

outcome.notes: Fachard prints the decipherment. August is editorial. Simonetta attributes I/3 to Giovanni da Poppi and suggests that the cipher signature was written in error.
